pipes.name: Sintex SWRX / SWRX PRO
pipes.full_name: Sintex SWRX™ Sewerage Waste Rain Water System (uPVC / SWRX PRO UPVC PLUS)
pipes.tagline: Next-Gen Sewerage, Waste Rain Water System
construction_types: Single layer of high-quality PVC material engineered to resist rodent damage
SWR PRO 3-Layer Pipe: Outer & inner layers made of UPVC & middle layer made of mineral-reinforced polypropylene with Anti-Rodent property

anti_rodent_technology.name: RATLOC™ Technology / NXT Advantage of Anti-Rodent Technology
anti_rodent_technology.detail: Specialized antirat composition available exclusively in 3-layer SWRX Sintex pipes that makes them highly unappealing to pests like rats and squirrels. Prevents chewing damage, leaks, blockages, hygiene problems, and system failures in residential, commercial, and industrial settings.

standards_compliance.pressure_type: Non-pressurized drainage / wastewater discharge systems (Ringfit seal tested up to 0.5 kg/cm²)

applications: Wastewater discharge from bathrooms, kitchens, and sanitary fixtures
Roof vents and Drain-Waste-Vent (DWV) systems maintaining stable air pressure in drainage networks
Residential, commercial, and industrial drainage networks

pipe_types.purpose: Designed specifically for rainwater and ventilation applications (roof vents, DWV systems).
Intended for handling soil and waste discharge.

ringfit.description: Integrated ring in the groove allows fast, easy push-fit installation. The spigot end simply pushes into the socket without any threading or adhesive required.
ringfit.sealing_material: PTFE and EPDM rubber rings ensuring a strong, leak-proof seal
ringfit.thermal_expansion_compensation: Accommodates thermal expansion and contraction; joints can be reopened for adjustments.
ringfit.thermal_expansion_rate: 0.06 mm/m/°C (a 2-meter pipe expands by 2.4 mm for a 20°C temperature rise)
advantages: Fast, push-fit assembly with zero adhesive
Accommodates building movement and thermal expansion
Re-openable joints for easy inspection and adjustment

selfit.description: Selfit pipes feature one plain end and one socketed end with a self-locking design for easy and reliable installation.
selfit.jointing_method: Joints are bonded with PVC solvent cement, creating a permanent, 100% watertight seal.
selfit.recommended_usage: Ideal for concealed drainage and recommended for horizontal installations where pipes are not exposed to sunlight, avoiding thermal expansion and contraction issues.
advantages: Ideal for concealed plumbing and interior horizontal runs

key_highlights: RATLOC™ Anti-Rodent Technology deterring rats & squirrels from chewing pipes
Unique 3-layer construction (outer/inner UPVC, middle mineral-reinforced polypropylene)
Available in Type A (Rainwater & Vent, Blue text) and Type B (Soil & Waste, White text)
Dual jointing: Ringfit (PTFE/EPDM push-fit, 0.5 kg/cm²) and Selfit (solvent cement permanent seal)
Thermal expansion compensation (0.06 mm/m/°C) with re-openable joints in Ringfit
100% UV stabilized for long-term outdoor sunlight exposure
Non-combustible & self-extinguishing upon heat source removal
Corrosion, acid, alkali, chemical, and effluent resistant
Smooth bore delivering unmatched hydraulic capacity and high flow rates
Environmentally friendly: Least energy-intensive thermoplastic, 100% recyclable

environmental_impact.title: Environmental Impact
environmental_impact.details: uPVC has lower feedstock energy compared to other polymers and common building materials; least energy-intensive of all thermoplastics. Life cycle analysis shows favorable environmental impact, minimized consumption of global resources, and 100% recyclability with zero harmful impact on air, water, or land.

anti_rat.title: Anti Rat (RATLOC™ Technology)
anti_rat.details: Rodent damage is a severe threat to underground and internal drainage. SWRX pipes feature specialized anti-rat composition exclusively in 3-layer pipes making them highly unappealing to pests, stopping gnawing and costly leaks.

three_layers_pipe.title: 3 Layers Pipe
three_layers_pipe.details: Robust multi-layer construction combining outer and inner UPVC with mineral-reinforced polypropylene middle core for superior strength and integrated anti-rat protection.

stronger_resilient_lightweight.title: Stronger, Resilient, and Lightweight
stronger_resilient_lightweight.details: Exceptional durability, resilience, impressive mechanical strength, and high impact resistance while remaining lightweight for effortless transportation and installation.

chemical_resistant.title: Chemical Resistant
chemical_resistant.details: Highly resistant to a wide range of acids, alkalis, effluents, salts, minerals, and aggressive soils.

corrosion_resistance.title: Corrosion Resistance
corrosion_resistance.details: Inherently immune to harsh chemicals, biological acids, and alkalis found in wastewater. Never scales or rusts, ensuring smooth unobstructed flow for decades.

quick_and_easy_installations.title: Quick and Easy Installations
quick_and_easy_installations.details: Easily connected using either rubber ring (Ringfit) or solvent weld (Selfit) system, ensuring completely leak-proof joints, reduced installation time, and minimal maintenance.

uv_stabilized.title: UV Stabilized
uv_stabilized.details: UV stabilized formulation provides durable protection against sunlight degradation, ensuring outdoor operational longevity.

high_flow_rates.title: High Flow Rates (Hydraulic Capacity)
high_flow_rates.details: Exceptionally smooth bores, precision joints, and absence of internal projections deliver unmatched hydraulic capacity, maintaining maximum flow rates throughout pipe lifespan.

flammability.title: Flammability & Fire Safety
flammability.details: Non-combustible and inherently resistant to ignition. Difficult to ignite and self-extinguishes immediately once heat source is removed.

economical.title: Economical
economical.details: Cost-effective alternative to traditional drainage systems (such as cast iron, concrete, or asbestos), offering value, lower labor costs, and long-term reliability.
